ask: See local token use, cache behavior, and cost by session, task, model, and source.
plugin: A statusline and command read local transcripts and OpenTelemetry events, attribute usage, and flag abnormal cache-read or retry patterns.

ask: Monitor available subscription or API allowance and warn before a limit interrupts work.
plugin: A statusline and monitor poll an accessible usage endpoint or read local usage data, show reset estimates, and send threshold alerts.

ask: Cap spend and stop runaway unattended or multi-agent work.
plugin: A settings hook enforces tool and agent-spawn policies; an experimental function hook measures each turn and aborts or denies work at configured ceilings.

ask: Choose economical models and effort for each task or subagent.
plugin: An experimental function hook intercepts agent.spawn and turn.step to select models, effort, provider, and escalation policy; a skill supplies task tiers.

ask: Reduce the context and cache cost of starting or resuming agents.
plugin: An experimental function hook trims agent prompts and injected context, filters optional startup blocks, and controls cache-friendly resumes where supported.

ask: Reduce repeated prompt-cache writes and avoid cache expiry in active sessions.
plugin: An experimental function hook stabilizes prompt sections, removes redundant attachments, adjusts cache policy where exposed, and reports misses.

ask: Manage conversation context and compaction without losing important work.
plugin: A command and experimental session.compact hook save checkpoints, guide summaries, veto harmful compactions, and surface context budget.

ask: Enable only the MCP servers and tools needed for a session or project.
plugin: A command and function hook select server profiles, defer tool schemas, and hide irrelevant tools and reminders.

ask: Keep MCP connector tokens usable across restarts, expiry, and account switches.
plugin: A companion MCP server and credential helper store per-server tokens, refresh them safely, and offer explicit reauthorization and diagnostics.

ask: Make third-party MCP authentication configurable and recoverable.
plugin: A companion MCP server or executable manages OAuth/PAT flows, refresh and client registration, then presents stable authenticated tools to Claude Code.

ask: Switch among separate Claude identities and project configurations predictably.
plugin: A bin launcher chooses an isolated profile directory and shows the active identity in a statusline; function hooks can label the session.

ask: Diagnose local credential conflicts and protect stored secrets.
plugin: A command inspects credential precedence, stale files, and unsafe storage, with an optional OS secret-store helper and redacted diagnostics.

ask: Use alternate model endpoints and normalize provider-specific protocol differences.
plugin: An MCP or local proxy executable adapts headers, model discovery, and request schemas; function hooks route supported sessions to it.

ask: Preserve useful progress and recover from limit or session interruptions.
plugin: A command writes a concise handoff and checkpoint to project state; a stop hook captures unfinished actions and offers resume instructions.

ask: Run scheduled and background checks only when useful and within budget.
plugin: A monitor and executable gate scheduled tasks on predicates, isolate their context, and record wakeups and completions.

ask: Use Claude Code predictably on metered or constrained connections.
plugin: A monitor and settings hook detect metered networking and defer bandwidth-heavy tools or background work until allowed.

ask: Steer Claude toward proportionate tools, bounded exploration, and cheaper edits.
plugin: A skill states task-sized workflows; settings hooks detect repeated reads, redundant calls, large outputs, and expensive operations before they recur.

ask: Identify untrusted instructions and enforce safety checks before risky changes.
plugin: A skill and PreToolUse hook flag prompt injection, require evidence for destructive or costly commands, and log provenance.

ask: Automate GitHub tasks without relying on the Claude GitHub app path.
plugin: An MCP server or command wraps gh for PR review, autofix, and repository operations using existing local credentials.

ask: Classify API failures and recover transient requests without repeated waste.
plugin: A function hook observes model request errors, applies bounded retries, and records actionable diagnostics; a command exports traces.

ask: Customize terminal status, banners, prompts, and small interaction affordances.
plugin: An experimental UI hook adds a status display or suppresses noisy banners and reminders; a statusline covers persistent indicators.

ask: Bridge design and artifact workflows to APIs usable from Claude Code.
plugin: An MCP server or command exposes design sync, artifact publish, and sharing operations where credentials and endpoints are available.

ask: Export detailed traces for model calls, tools, retries, and sessions.
plugin: A settings hook and monitor join local OpenTelemetry and transcript records into request-level traces with source attribution.

ask: Control and inspect a running Claude Code session from an external orchestrator.
plugin: An experimental function hook starts a local control endpoint for session state, model and effort changes, and safe command dispatch.
